'''Damarcus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Affiliated with the [[House of Thul]] and wearing their uniform, he sold various weapons near the [[Thul Palace]].

==Behind the scenes==
Damarcus appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Weapons Vendor for Imperial players on Alderaan. With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]], Damarcus was removed from the game along with the rest of the Weapons Vendors.<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
